author: quinnanm
body:
update hls4mlEmulatorExtras to [v1.1.6 ](https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/hls4mlEmulatorExtras/releases/tag/v1.1.6)
adds fix for early model destruction https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/hls4mlEmulatorExtras/issues/7 as included in https://github.com/cms-hls4ml/hls4mlEmulatorExtras/pull/8 (avoid early dlclose call). Spotted in https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51633 

Also adds fix to shared pointer type mismatch found [here](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/10770#issuecomment-5218468633). 

Will backport to 20_0_X
title: Update hls4mlEmulatorExtras to v1.1.6
